agent_note: Clean past-tense third-person narration with heavy free indirect discourse across two sisters (Jo, Bethie). Quotation marks survived on roughly half the dialogue quotes; where absent I used vocatives, direct address, first/second-person deixis and colloquial register, noted per quote. Two attributed epigraphs discarded as paratext, one rhyming couplet abstained as verse. q04170 is a past-tense proverb allusion with no story-world referent -- the contested past-tense gnomic case, flagged rather than decided silently. All 24 event quotes are past; no present event-narration anywhere in the sample.
